name: COSINUS
full_name: Cryogenic Observatory for SIgnatures seen in Next generation Underground Searches
summary: COSINUS tests the DAMA signal with cryogenic NaI calorimeters, adding event-by-event nuclear/electron recoil discrimination in the same target material.
detection_principle: Heat/phonons and scintillation light from NaI crystals are read out together; their ratio identifies interaction type. An external water-Cherenkov system vetoes muons.

results.summary: An underground NaI prototype demonstrates dual readout and a direct dark-matter search method.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
